newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar down on poor demand in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar down on poor demand in moderate trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices dropped on Tuesday on poor demand from both retailers and wholesalers, traders said.
"Sluggish consumer buying as well as negligible enquiries from the retailers dragged prices down," a trader said.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 fell 5 rupees to 1,235/1,280 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved down by 10 rupees to 1,265/1,355 rupees per quintal.
Arrivals were higher on sustained offerings by mill owners ahead of the federal budget scheduled for Friday, traders said.
Sugar mill delivery recovered marginally by 5 rupees to 1,180/1,190 rupees per quintal on fresh enquiries from mills, they added.
Overall the market sentiment was subdued at close in dull trade and traders said they expected prices to remain range-bound till the end of the month.
